title: Live Activities | Apple Developer Documentation - [Offering interactivity](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/live-activities\#Offering-interactivity)
claim: Consider letting people respond to event or progress updates.** If an update to your Live Activity is something that a person could respond to, consider offering a button or toggle to let people take action. For example, the Live Activity of a rideshare app could include a button to contact the driver while waiting for a ride to arrive.
